name: CTPelvic1K
what: 172 pelvic CT volumes of the release's datasets 6 and 7, with the pelvic masks of datasets 1 to 5 mapped back to their sources

segmentations.masks: the pelvic masks of the release's datasets 1 to 5: the lumbar spine as one label, the sacrum and both hips, mapped back to the source CTs, which other records hold; dataset 2's masks are at the folder named, which the data platform notes is on a delete list and may be stale
segmentations.by: the release's annotators, under a radiologist

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together; over the release's datasets 6 and 7, which this record holds
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them
